clan.description: Welcome to   NOVA AURORA  -  A New Dawn on the horizon.We are a level 100 guild which offers:- 40% boost for recruitment and heal- 20 fp Research Boost per day- 25% Building RebateWe have active 1.9, 1.92, 1.95 threads.We have a solid core of top fighters who give it their all each and every season.  We welcome all players who enjoy the fight and will jump in at every opportunity.  Always room for that core to grow.Our seasoned players are happy to offer advice, answer questions and help you with any goals you may have set for yourself.  We do have a few must do's but they are fairly straight forward...1. Fair Trades, including respecting the eras.  2. GE, enter into or finish lvl 5. 3. QI – the benefits of playing QI are huge so we encourage everyone to give it their best.  At minimum you must build a settlement and spend some action points to get you on the leader board.  It is expected that you strive to improve your QI ranking.4. Arc lvl 80+ or be prepared to work tirelessly to get it there. Also one other treasury GB – Obs, AI, ATO, Hydra – being levelled consistently.5. GBG Minimum 750 points every season.  1000 is strongly encouraged. 6. Minimum Era - Each applicant considered regardless of Era.  If joining will be a problem for our treasury the applicant must commit to donating the era minimum per day.7. Treasury - Each Era has a minimum daily donations that  members are expected to meet.It's a reasonable amount considering all the event buildings that give TGs.If you're keen to grow your city with us while contributing to NA's growth and success, please make an application.Guild Primary Contacts: Cord, Katia Grim, Frank1e, Grendeth, JTALuckyHISTORY...Nova Aurora is a merger between two historical guilds Sentinels & Prometheus Lair.   Establish in March 2024 but with over 12 years of history & tradition. Sentinels finished 5th in world after GVG finishedPrometheus Lair was established 2021 from a merge between Prometheus Rising and The LairThis physical guild was Est circa 2012 as Prometheus Rising.
